title: Kalman Filter
text: Compute output, error, and weights using least mean squares (LMS) adaptive algorithm, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Reset port} sets Reset port; {Algorithm} selects algorithm, {Filter length}, {Specify step size via} sets the step size, {Step size (mu)}, {Leakage factor (0 to 1)}, {Initial value of filter weights}, {Adapt port}, {Output filter weights}, {Rounding mode} sets the method of rounding, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Parameters}, {Weights} sets the word and fraction length of filter weights Same as first, {Product and quotient} sets the word and fraction length of product and quotient Same as first, {Accumulator} sets the word and fraction lengths of accumulators Same as first and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: Estimate of desired signal scalar | column vector

ports.name: Error
ports.summary: Error between output and desired signals scalar | column vector
